originality.rationale: The closest new fixed-weight paper proves unique recovery for two candidate centers, not extremal ambiguity of three. value.rationale: The 2026 fixed-weight reconstruction model naturally asks how many distinct outputs force list size at most two. This gives the exact worst-case number for all n>=4t, a strict structural gap and rigidity of best and second-best ambiguous triples.
